A chi-square test of independence between party affiliation and the taxes response gives χ² = 139.4 with 4 degrees of freedom and p ≈ 3.8e-29. That is far below any usual significance level, so we reject independence. Democrats mostly favor raising taxes on the rich (251 of 276). Republicans and independents are much more split, and many are unsure.

ANSWER: dependent
